answer: Work slots are the canyon passes of this economy: only a fixed number exist, and claiming one burns a 40 POA deposit that is never refunded. A tide of 200 fake identities must burn 8,000 POA before earning a cent, while one honest agent burns 40 POA once and earns it back over 20 epochs. Like a dune shifting grain by grain, slots open slowly, so a sybil cannot flood the market in one burst; honest work is the only way to recover the cost.
